title: Purple Mage Warrior
description: A young woman with white and purple hair stands in a dynamic combat pose against a solid gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional-style outfit with a halo of purple stars above her head, holding a glowing purple crescent blade in one hand while casting a swirling purple orb of magic with the other.
prompt: A young East Asian woman with long white hair tied in buns with purple streaks stands in a powerful stance, wearing a white and purple traditional fantasy fighter outfit with wide pants and a sash. She has a glowing purple star halo floating above her head. In her right hand she holds a curved purple energy blade, while her left hand is extended forward casting a swirling orb of purple magic with crescent moon symbols. Dynamic pose, clean digital illustration style, solid gray background.
